name: Virginia VISAA State Cross Country Championships
headline: Virginia VISAA State Cross Country Championships
summary: Final: Division I: Norfolk Academy won the boys title with 99 points over St. Stephen’s and St. Agnes (107) as Bishop Ireton’s Jason Day won in 15:36.4, and The Potomac School beat Collegiate 56-70 for the girls title as Collegiate’s Virginia Harris won in 18:43.6. Division II: North Cross swept both team titles with 39 points each, led by individual champions Finton Chaney (16:04.1) and Kaitlyn Perkins (19:27.7). Division III: Tandem Friends won the boys title (58) behind Hayes Buppert’s 15:41.0, and Trinity Academy Meadow View edged Timberlake Christian 75-79 for the girls title as Walsingham Academy’s Remington Freeman won in 18:58.2.
